name: Uiverse
observed: Community HTML/CSS, Tailwind and React elements.
license_review: MIT stated for UI elements; retain author and license notice.
integration: Select HTML/CSS entries; compile Tailwind and remove framework/runtime requirements.

name: AIMRAN Library
observed: 814 items advertised; HTML/CSS and React + Motion mixed.
license_review: Free claim; redistribution license not verified on inspected index.
integration: Only dependency-free entries fit module v1. React + Motion needs a runtime adapter.

name: CodeHarem
observed: Native components with previews and copy controls.
license_review: Publisher allows personal/commercial use; a complete redistribution license was not verified.
integration: Study native state and editor UX; independently implement until redistribution terms are recorded.

name: GEMILAN Code
observed: Initial index advertised 1,148 native components and MIT; later fetch returned 404.
license_review: MIT publisher claim observed; exact component license and stable availability need recheck.
integration: Treat as a provisional source. Do not assume dashboard dependencies match component dependencies.

name: CodeFronts
observed: CSS/Tailwind collections with editor, preview and exports.
license_review: MIT stated on index; preserve selected author/license.
integration: Use vanilla subsets or compile utility CSS first.

name: WebDevSnippets
observed: Native, Tailwind and Bootstrap examples; framework requirements vary.
license_review: Redistribution license not verified on inspected index.
integration: Record original author, dependency list and license per snippet.

name: FreeFrontend
observed: Large curated index linking individual authors and demos.
license_review: No blanket clearance inferred; inspect each original source.
integration: Use discovery links; do not bulk package the aggregator.

name: HyperUI
observed: Tailwind CSS components for applications, marketing and commerce.
license_review: MIT; retain notice.
integration: Compile required Tailwind styles and scope the result before module installation.

name: CodeShack Snippets
observed: HTML/CSS/JS examples, forms, navigation and effects.
license_review: Redistribution license not verified on inspected index.
integration: Separate static markup from scripts and verify per-item rights.

name: Purely CSS
observed: Community HTML/CSS library, including details disclosures and loaders.
license_review: Redistribution license not verified on inspected index.
integration: Review keyboard behavior; CSS-only does not establish accessibility.

name: CodePeek
observed: Community elements in HTML/CSS and Tailwind; index includes license statement.
license_review: MIT stated in footer; retain creator attribution/license.
integration: Check exact source and native semantics before adapting.

name: Movin Components
observed: Animated components in native HTML/CSS/JS and React + Tailwind.
license_review: MIT-0 confirmed in linked repository; attribution not required by license.
integration: Native CSS-only subsets fit. JS interactions and shadcn CLI imports require a separate integration path.

name: Animated UI Library
observed: Native and React animated examples, including Canvas-based effects.
license_review: Free claim; redistribution license not verified on inspected index.
integration: CSS loaders fit conceptually; Canvas requires script runtime.

name: CSS Buttons
observed: Button designs link back to individual Uiverse creators.
license_review: Follow Uiverse MIT terms and preserve each selected creator/source.
integration: Reuse the original Button Atlas static adapters supplied in this pack.

name: Button Interaction Specs
observed: 131 mechanisms advertised; useful uniform-button comparison.
license_review: MIT repository; retain notice if copying.
integration: Use as comparison vocabulary. Current pack independently implements 10 static patterns.

name: CSS Loaders
observed: 600+ single-element CSS loader examples advertised.
license_review: Exact source license not confirmed by inspected page; no third-party loader copied.
integration: Use bounded animations, status text and reduced-motion fallback.

name: Loading.css
observed: Repeatable CSS motion presets; index and repository counts differ.
license_review: MIT stated in loadingio/loading.css repository.
integration: Extract only selected keyframes; namespace names and support reduced motion.

name: Animista
observed: Generates selected CSS animations with timing, delay and easing controls.
license_review: Generated CSS is labeled FreeBSD licensed on official site.
integration: Preserve generated license header; namespace keyframes and expose timing tokens.

name: Animation Playground
observed: 140+ CSS/SVG/Canvas examples advertised.
license_review: Repository license not verified; do not infer MIT from public visibility.
integration: Split CSS-only effects from JS/Canvas effects before integration.

name: Pure CSS
observed: Native CSS interaction pattern site; different from purelycss.com and purecss.io.
license_review: Terms page inspected; no blanket redistribution grant recorded for this pack.
integration: Prefer native details/inputs; do not treat :target overlays as complete accessible dialogs.

name: 10015 CSS Tools
observed: Visual CSS generators for shapes, gradients, shadows and related properties.
license_review: Generated output terms not verified; no site implementation copied.
integration: Use as authoring workflow reference; our token controls are independent.

name: Clippy
observed: Interactive clip-path polygon generator.
license_review: Site source license not checked; output and tool source are separate concerns.
integration: Store editable polygon values in CSS; provide non-clipped fallback.

name: React Bits Creative Tools
observed: Background, presentation, shape and texture authoring tools.
license_review: Core React Bits code uses MIT + Commons Clause; tool/output terms require separate review.
integration: Do not label entire product plain MIT. React/Shader exports need runtime integration.

name: Lucide
observed: Consistent customizable SVG icons with multiple package adapters.
license_review: ISC; listed Feather-derived icons additionally carry MIT notices.
integration: Inline selected SVG with required notices; avoid shipping the whole icon library. No Lucide files bundled here.

name: SVG Repo
observed: Aggregated SVG library with multiple per-icon licenses.
license_review: Per-item terms; default SVG Repo license restricts equivalent-library redistribution and as-is resale.
integration: Select and record exact author/license. Do not bulk mirror icons into a competing catalog.

name: CSSUI
observed: Pure CSS interaction components, CSS variables and standard HTML.
license_review: MIT stated on official site.
integration: Review semantics, duplicate IDs and keyboard behavior per component before adapting.
